name: Koreatown Plaza
summary: Since 1988, Koreatown Plaza has been the cultural and commercial heart of LA's Koreatown, offering three stories of authentic Korean retail, dining, and entertainment. This landmark destination features diverse Asian restaurants, specialty shops, and a welcoming center atrium that serves as a gathering place for the community.
demographics: Koreatown Plaza attracts a diverse demographic with a strong concentration of Korean-American and Asian-American visitors, typically ranging from young professionals in their 20s-40s to multigenerational families. The trade area serves the densely populated Koreatown neighborhood of Los Angeles, drawing middle to upper-middle income households seeking authentic Korean products, dining, and cultural experiences. Shoppers are often bilingual, culturally connected to Korean trends, and value authentic ethnic retail and dining options. The center also attracts food enthusiasts and cultural tourists from across the greater Los Angeles area seeking Korean cuisine and specialty goods.
description: Since 1988, Koreatown Plaza has served as the epicenter for Korean culture, flavors, and trends in Los Angeles. This sprawling 3-story shopping mall stands as a cultural landmark in the heart of Koreatown, offering an immersive experience that goes far beyond typical retail. The center features a diverse mix of retail shops specializing in Korean fashion, beauty products, and specialty goods, alongside an impressive range of authentic Asian restaurants that have made it a culinary destination. The distinctive center atrium creates a welcoming gathering space that reflects the community-oriented nature of Korean culture. With over three decades of history, Koreatown Plaza has evolved into more than just a shopping center—it's a cultural hub where tradition meets contemporary Korean trends, serving as a bridge between heritage and modern lifestyle for the vibrant Koreatown community and visitors from across Southern California.
